Enumeration by Direct Search

Abstract

We enumerate finite topologies by orderly generation with isomorph rejection.

1. Introduction

Direct search is conceptually simpler than the transfer matrix method.

2. Orderly generation

Canonical augmentation avoids generating isomorphs.

3. Conclusions

Direct search is competitive for small n and verifies transfer matrix results.

References

  1. P. Alexandroff. Diskrete Räume. Mat. Sbornik, 2:501-519, 1937.
  2. R. Stanley. On the number of open sets of finite topologies. J. Combin. Theory, 10(1):74-79, 1971. doi:10.1016/S0021-9800(71)80011-5
  3. M. Erne. Struktur- und Anzahlformeln fur Topologien auf endlichen Mengen. Manuscripta Math., 11:221-259, 1974.
